primary_measurement: Matched full three-second time-mean absolute yaw after the snapshot. Compare candidate to the mean of two reference arms. Measure repeat separation as the 95th percentile of scene absolute difference between references.
contact_cycle_measurement: Among common evaluable worlds, measure two complete left-to-left and two complete right-to-right strides after the input ramp, each with opposite support between onsets.
admission: Both development cohorts must show a three-second median reduction greater than the reference-repeat 95th percentile, median decreases in both contact-anchored views, and at least 116 worlds with projected full-route yaw at or below 0.20 rad/s and the rest of the original forward gates on the observed route. Projection is a screen for the existing full 20-second test.
